::: {.lede}
I develop targeted and non-targeted analytical chemistry methods — and the
data-processing tools and workflows behind them — to detect chemicals of emerging
concern in the environment. My work pairs high-resolution mass spectrometry with
non-targeted analysis to tackle problems ranging from PFAS in drinking water to
rapid emergency response.
:::

I'm a Physical Scientist (GS-14) at the U.S. EPA's Office of Applied Science and
Environmental Solutions (OASES), where I lead research that turns complex mass-spectrometry
data into actionable identifications of unknown compounds in environmental media.

### Focus areas

<ul class="chips">
<li>Non-targeted analysis (NTA)</li>
<li>High-resolution mass spectrometry</li>
<li>PFAS identification</li>
<li>Data-processing tools &amp; workflows</li>
<li>Suspect screening</li>
<li>Method performance evaluation</li>
<li>Drinking-water contaminants</li>
<li>GC–HRMS</li>
</ul>
